item.description: Sri Lanka’s High Court has found 15 of the 24 men accused of being directly involved in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings guilty. The attacks killed 279 people and wounded around 500. A 15th defendant was found guilty of only some of the charges, while nine others were acquitted. The...
